source_autosprite.prompt: Click reaction: Rabi is happily surprised, tiny wave, ear-wing appendages flap, halo/core sparkle, blue wisps pop, bounce then settle. Full body stable.

runtime_sheet.frame_interval: intended one-shot pingpong; 49 AutoSprite frames + deterministic reverse 48..0

postprocess.tool: AutoSprite MCP + Real-ESRGAN animev3 x4 RGB/alpha split + 1152px safe-margin pingpong repack
postprocess.operation: AutoSprite 49f source cells were scaled to 84 percent and centered. RGB cells were alpha-bled and Real-ESRGAN x4 upscaled to 2048, downsampled to 1152, lightly sharpened, then recombined with source alpha resized separately. Final sheet uses deterministic forward+reverse 98f pingpong assembly.

face_nukki_cleanup.tool: OpenCV connected-component dark matte removal + edge-color inpaint
face_nukki_cleanup.operation: Removed low-alpha black/gray matte components around the face, ear-wing edges, and tail, then inpainted remaining neutral dark alpha-edge pixels with nearby colors while preserving opaque eye/mouth line art.

face_nukki_cleanup_v4.tool: Pillow + OpenCV targeted side-cavity matte removal
face_nukki_cleanup_v4.operation: Second cleanup pass for the visible black cutout artifacts around Rabi face. Transparentized neutral black/gray matte residue only inside the left/right under-face and inner ear-wing cavity zones, while excluding eye, mouth, forehead, and central gold collar regions.

qa.pingpong_loop_closure: frame0 == frame97 and frame48 == frame49 by deterministic reverse assembly
qa.status: Accepted runtime candidate: Rabi SD-identity click Live2D sheet with happy-surprise bounce, ear-wing flap, halo/core sparkle, and blue wisp pop.
qa.face_nukki_cleanup: Passed: connected low-alpha dark matte residue around the face/ears was removed; opaque eye and mouth line art preserved.
qa.face_nukki_cleanup_v4: Passed: visible black/gray cutout residue around the face-side cavities was removed; eye, mouth, forehead mark, and central gold collar line art preserved.
